sentences.en: To my knowledge, this chemical will prevent germs from breeding.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，这种化学物质可以防止细菌滋生。

sentences.en: Do you all understand the difference between germs and viruses?
sentences.zh: 你们都明白细菌和病毒的区别吗？

sentences.en: The most common germ spread from turtles is called Salmonella.
sentences.zh: 最常见的来自乌龟的病原体叫做沙门氏菌。
